svg.title: How a suggested code becomes your coding
svg.desc: Three made-up survey answers are listed. QualSafe puts a suggested code beside each one, shown with a dashed outline and a question mark. A tick moves down the list as you read each answer. The second suggestion is wrong, so it is replaced with the code you choose. The suggestions you agree with become solid, and what you decide is what is counted.

text.tspan: The textbooks cost more than I planned for.
My roommate and I study together every week.
My advisor answered every email within a day.
QualSafe suggests a code for each answer.
You read each answer and its suggestion.
Where a suggestion is wrong, you change it.
What you decide is what gets counted.
